data.name: Afiyaa
data.gender_notes: Afiyaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'afy', meaning to heal or comfort. In Islamic tradition, Afiyaa is a name given to girls, symbolizing their role as healers and comforters within their families and communities. The name Afiyaa carries the meaning “Healer, Comforter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afiyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody healer, comforter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the presence of Allah's healing and happiness in one's life
data.etymology: Afiyaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healer, Comforter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afiyaa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

This name, meaning 'healing' or 'comfort', is often given to girls to symbolize their role in promoting emotional and spiritual well-being within their families and communities. In many Muslim societies, women are traditionally seen as caretakers and sources of comfort, and a name like Afiyaa reinforces these cultural roles and expectations.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Afiyaa" represents the idea of healing and comfort as holy and purposeful tasks. In Islamic teachings, caring for others is a way to serve and worship God by contributing to the well-being of His creation. By bestowing the name Afiyaa upon their daughter, the parents and community are recognizing the spiritual significance of her role as a healer and comforter, encouraging her to focus on nurturing herself and others with love, kindness, and compassion. This name serves as a constant reminder of the blessings that come from taking care of others and creating healing relationships with those around us.
